summary: This clinical trial compares two drugs, HRS9531 and semaglutide, given once a week to adults with type 2 diabetes. Type 2 diabetes is a long-lasting condition where the body cannot properly control its blood sugar levels. All participants take metformin, a common diabetes medicine, either alone or with another type of medicine called an SGLT2 inhibitor. The trial has a status of Completed and included 884 participants.
